scope: Documentation-only extraction of literal protocol facts from the restored provenance modules; not consumed by training and not a replacement trainer. Dynamic data paths, hashes and environment are intentionally omitted.

facts.loss: nll_loss(log_softmax(logits, dim=1), label); mean; no class weights
facts.augmentation: train: HFlip p=.5; scale U(.9,1.1), center crop/zero pad; retain U(.9,1), random crop then bilinear resize; val/test augment=False
facts.pretrained_adaptation: CNN and ViT 3->9 repeat /3; ViT positional grid bicubic 14x14->6x6; load once, strict=False matching keys
facts.checkpoint_selection: Validation AUC strictly increases (val_auc > best_val_auc); ties keep earlier; Test excluded
facts.precision: Precision = Precision_Malignant = TP/(TP+FP); undefined returns NaN
facts.precision_weighted: precision_score(full labels, full predictions, average="weighted", zero_division=0)
